text: The tool predicted Guideline F as AGAINST, which led to a DENIED recommendation. Its disqualifier findings rest on a history of not meeting financial obligations and an inability to satisfy debts, with the tool noting that the applicant is "not making any debt payments" at present. Mitigating factors were also found, including a divorce-related mortgage delinquency and a debt payment plan, but the tool judged that the repayment efforts were not sustained. The tool concluded the efforts "were not sustained long enough to conclude that the problem is under control".
